overall_summary: Space-themed mysteries and mind-bending natural history facts (e.g., sharks being older than trees, space oceans, and space smells) are currently driving the highest engagement and views. Conversely, generic brain-related psychology facts and repetitive topics are underperforming, indicating a need to shift focus toward cosmic scale and paradoxical natural phenomena.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Largest Ocean in Space Will Mind-Blow You!' (460 views, 5 likes) and 'What Does Outer Space Actually Smell Like?' (368 views, 4 likes) are the top-performing videos in the dataset.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more content exploring extreme cosmic environments, focusing on sensory details (smells, sounds, textures) or massive scales that are hard for the human brain to comprehend.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Sharks Are Older Than Trees?' (301 views, 3 likes) and 'This Animal Literally Dies Every Winter!' (179 views, 3 likes) show strong relative performance.
winning_patterns.action: Create shorts comparing historical timelines of species or bizarre survival mechanisms of animals using a highly contrasting hook.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (17 views), 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' (39 views), and 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (54 views) consistently struggle to gain traction.
weak_patterns.action: Pause generic cognitive bias and brain-fact videos unless they can be tied to a massive, highly unusual real-world event or mystery.

next_video.reason: Aligns with the highly successful space-mystery theme of our top videos and utilizes a powerful visual paradox to maximize early retention.
